evaluation.name: SuperPoint 2018, section 7.3 and appendix A
evaluation.preprocessing: OpenCV grayscale decode and INTER_LINEAR resize to width=640, height=480; no crop.
evaluation.matching: One-way nearest neighbor, L2 for floating descriptors / Hamming for ORB; no ratio or mutual filter; no ground-truth feature filtering.
evaluation.estimator: OpenCV findHomography RANSAC: 3 px, maxIters=2000, confidence=0.995, RNG seed=42.
evaluation.geometry: Mean error of four corners in resized-image pixels; H-Acc <= 1/3/5; all failed estimates count as incorrect.
evaluation.failure_policy: No extra inlier-count, inlier-ratio or photometric-overlap gate.
evaluation.comparability: 公开评测设置对齐；原论文评测代码未公开，具体实现存在差异。

dataset_protocol: All 116 sequences, reference image 1 against 2..6 (580 pairs), no sequence exclusion. Homography estimation protocol, not the original descriptor-patch benchmark.

xfeat.variant: sparse detectAndCompute; no XFeat* or LighterGlue
xfeat.timing: Model initialization and worker warmup excluded; pair I/O and inference included.
